title: 25 M.P.T.L. ch. 1 § 1 (TITLE 25 RESIDENTIAL FORECLOSURE AND EVICTION LAW)
text:
Section 1. Short Title
This Law shall be known as the Residential Foreclosure and Eviction Law of
the Mashantucket Pequot Tribal Nation (the “Tribe or MPTN”).
document: TITLE 25 RESIDENTIAL FORECLOSURE AND EVICTION LAW
